name: mixer-capability-execution-v1
authority: These definitions alone enable no runtime, effects, release or publication. Execution requires an implementing trusted installed binary, matching immutable identity/material, verified signed selection and all specified gates. Proposal/implementation/qualification status is tracked outside these byte-hashed files.
contract_format: bounded protocol reference with closed structural schemas; lexical, cross-field, full executable and authority checks remain mandatory; JSON Schema alone never authorizes execution

startup_and_memory.byte_fuel: extra ceil(sum of copied bytes/64), including8 token bytes or4 length bytes, before allocation/write/consume; pending and tooSmall length writes charged; dispatch/host-call fuel remains unchanged; exhaustion zeroes remaining fuel and makes no partial copy

reservation: each accepted request reserves arguments length plus524288completion bytes; argument snapshot+reservation must fit installed native reservation; lower positive quotas may deny all calls

ownership.dispatch: only a fully successful current guest turn publishes calls; trapping/cancelled/closed turns never start their queued work
ownership.scope: raw token bits scoped to exact native handle/generation and operation; equal bits in another owner never confer identity
ownership.native_exit: successful take Call creates one counted exit obligation; only first successful actual/no-I/O ack decrements; terminal/delivery/cancel/drop is not exit
ownership.close: stop admission, permanent cancel, retained closing ack identity; normal tickets remain ackable after guest close; poison/quarantine denies ack and pins capacity
ownership.registry: one archive and one shared16pool; never registry lock to ledger/mailbox; final destruction outside Reclaiming lock; no second default archive
ownership.cleanup_exception: quarantined but unpoisoned cancel/close mayreturn0 for transition only; sticky quarantine/capacity remains; poison returns4
ownership.status: native0..4, guest import0..7, typed completion failures and VM traps are separate domains; require checked report/status/kind and numeric alias preflight

input.json: one strict UTF8 object; closed mandatory fields; reject duplicate decoded keys, unknown fields, BOM, trailing values, comments, null, malformed UTF8/surrogates and numeric coercion
input.canonical_bytes: sorted ASCII object keys; compact separators; ASCII escaping; unsigned shortest decimal integers; arrays in required order; one final LF; exact re-encoding equality required
input.hash: SHA256 of exact captured canonical file bytes; verify before parse and before object construction; never hash one representation and instantiate another path/DTO
input.roles: exactly one bridge-policy file plus configuration and installed-grant files for each of zero..two installed capability entries; no missing, duplicate or unused role; no path lookup by guest/release; all snapshots immutable for owner lifetime

installed_material.grant_rules: exact existing grant schema1 family rules; native installed files grant only an envelope; signed verified grants intersect independently; missing/empty denies
installed_material.configuration_binding: HTTP concurrency and CapabilityHost maximumRequests equal identity maximum_requests N; host timeout equals identity timeout; storage namespaces derive from same installed grant snapshot; never substitute release namespaces for installed configuration
installed_material.empty_storage_namespaces: empty installed namespaces deny and omit storage adapter; do not call current SDK storage initializer with empty namespaces or fabricate a namespace
installed_material.factory: after full identity/material/payload validation, construct concrete closed adapters from those same immutable bytes; no independently supplied policy/DTO/HTTP closure/session/trust override/storage root
installed_material.storage_container: trusted native application-private container plus checked single component; no per-device absolute root in universal fingerprint; no guest/release path
installed_material.host_initialization: private storage initialization may create/lock files; zero guest dispatch is not zero host filesystem activity
installed_material.sdk_binding: require linked known SDK native identity plus captured actual source/artifact/config identities; a declared digest alone is not proof runtime objects match

scheduler.semantics: off-UI serialized bounded pump; coalesced timer/events, round-robin, cancel/expire before admission; no immediate busy retry or unbounded queue; batch budget is not preemption
scheduler.close_ownership: one coalesced detached host-close task and one coalesced off-UI native-close dispatch job per owner, counted separately; neither creates a per-callback fanout

deadlines: Rust authoritative deadline never renewed; checked remaining floorR, Swift sampleS before query yields D=S+R; min previous D, argument HTTP timeout and installed timeout; carry noLaterThan across actor queues; expiry/cancel cannot undo admitted external effects

native_boundary.pointer_preflight: full nonwrapping numeric ranges and aliases including report before any output; all writable overlaps reject without writing; required pointers cannot be null; caller guarantees actual live storage, numeric checks cannot validate dangling pointers
native_boundary.symbol_rule: mixer_vm_capability_ + function + _v1; nondefault native feature only; C has no native I/O/JSON/grant validation/scheduler/Swift continuation

native_boundary.deadline_query: remaining0 means terminal/expiry and never extends I/O authority; terminal result0kind1 remaining0; no renewal

Those require separate accountable evidence.
